purpose: Truthful per-product-line implementation baseline. The two state fields are independent: code_implemented says an executable path exists with focused tests; scenario_validated says a permissioned real-world scenario ran the declared acceptance set with recorded evidence and independent review. A product may be code_implemented and still scenario_validated=false.

field_definitions.code_implemented: Executable code path exists in this repository (or the named owning repository) and focused automated tests cover its declared behavior.
field_definitions.scenario_validated: A permissioned real scenario was executed end-to-end and passed the predeclared acceptance set, with recorded evidence (bundles/fingerprints/commit SHAs) and independent review.
field_definitions.not_implemented: No executable implementation is verified; only documents or plans exist.

release_rule: code_implemented=true MUST NOT be read as scenario_validated. Unit tests do not validate a scenario. Missing or unsupported evidence is inconclusive, never pass.

asserted_by_mission.RA_acceptance_evidence.verdict: implied pass (brief says R5 review green, m23157 accepted=true)

reconciled.RA_acceptance_evidence.maturity_verdict_: id=903 and id=918 cited by the reviews; m23157 row via docs/m23157/verdict_insert_r5.sql

mission_baseline_reconciliation.reason: Two part of the brief reconcile, one does not. (1) code_implemented=true is confirmed and now recorded: main ships the reviewed recheck.py byte-for-byte (sha256 2cfa2454...), PR#511 is an ancestor of main@3fbd3b3, and the entry point exits 0 on a cold extraction. (2) 'six checks pass' and 'PR#511 merged' are also confirmed. (3) scenario_validated=true is not supportable. The R5 receipt that this brief calls green records verdict=changes_requested, scenario_validated=false, and two unfixed residuals that this mission re-measured on main@3fbd3b3: 127 of 144 file locators still do not resolve in a cold checkout (114 legacy runs/m22059 prefixes, 17 absolute /root/tp-agent refs) and the reviewer manifest is still unsound (4 missing + 1 mismatch of 18). Independently, TensorBench/tensorbench/contracts.py::_status_errors rejects scenario_validated=true whenever acceptance_evidence.verdict != 'pass', so writing true here would fail the canonical validator and would launder a changes_requested verdict into an acceptance. The brief's 'm23157 accepted=true' is best read as the m23157 mission being accepted as a delivery (its changes_requested verdict is the accepted output), not as the RA scenario passing acceptance; conflating the two is the substantive defect this publication refuses to encode. Rows 917/918 could not be read back (this role has no SELECT on tensor_maturity_verdicts - see status_evidence.json#verdict_ledger); the shipped reviews cite id=903 (D1-D12) and id=918 (R4 residuals), and no in-repo citation of a row 917 was found, so the brief's '917' is left unreconciled rather than silently plausible.
